description.en: AVBench evaluates audio-video generative models across ten fine-grained dimensions covering visual quality, audio quality, and cross-modal consistency for human-centric scenarios. It uses specialized evaluators trained via preference learning and provides continuous scores from prediction confidence.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing benchmarks for AV generation are coarse and rely on generic multimodal LLMs, leading to inaccurate assessments. AVBench offers automated, human-aligned evaluation with fine-grained metrics, enabling reliable model comparison and serving as a potential reward signal for RLHF.
